neighbours.label: words for physical self-movement / locomotion (run, jump, leap, moves, mobility, movement)
fire: The young gymnast can leap higher than anyone else on her team.
After the knee surgery, his mobility improved slowly over many months.
The tall striker moves quickly into the open space behind the defenders.
Every morning our old dog still likes to run along the beach.
The dancer's graceful movement across the stage stunned the audience.
When they are startled, kangaroos jump great distances across the plain.
The little frog made one long hop toward the edge of the pond.
Many older patients have trouble walking for weeks after a fall.
quiet: The young gymnast has won more medals than anyone else on her team.
After the knee surgery, his appetite improved slowly over many months.
The tall striker earns a huge salary at his new club this year.
Every morning our old dog still likes to sleep by the window.
The dancer's elegant costume on the stage stunned the audience.
When they are young, kangaroos stay inside their mother's pouch for months.
The little frog had bright green skin and round golden eyes.
Many older patients have trouble remembering names for weeks after a fall.

notes: Card top examples: moves, leap, mobility, movement, run, jump; the shared pattern is a body moving itself through space.
